gloss: transfer to a different facility; relocation

definitions.gloss: transfer to a different facility; relocation of placement
definitions.explanation: The act of transferring a person from one facility, institution, or care center to another. Commonly used in welfare, medical, and institutional contexts for transfers between care homes, hospitals, or detention facilities.

examples.japanese: {別|べつ}の{施設|しせつ}に{転所|てんしょ}する。
{患者|かんじゃ}は{回復期|かいふくき}リハビリ{病院|びょういん}に{転所|てんしょ}した。
examples.english: The patient was transferred to a rehabilitation hospital.

examples.japanese: {介護|かいご}{施設|しせつ}の{定員|ていいん}オーバーのため、{一部|いちぶ}の{入所者|にゅうしょしゃ}は{近隣|きんりん}の{施設|しせつ}に{転所|てんしょ}することになった。
examples.english: Due to the care facility being over capacity, some residents will be transferred to nearby facilities.

notes:
A compound of {転|てん} (transfer/change) and {所|しょ} (place/facility). Used specifically for institutional transfers — when a person is moved from one facility or institution to another.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {施設|しせつ}の{転所|てんしょ}: facility transfer
- {転所|てんしょ}{手続|てつづ}き: transfer procedures
- {転所|てんしょ}{先|さき}: destination facility (after transfer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転院|てんいん}: hospital transfer (specifically between hospitals)
- {転居|てんきょ}: change of residence; moving house (general relocation)
- {異動|いどう}: personnel transfer (within an organization, for employees)
- {入所|にゅうしょ}: admission to a facility (entering a care home, institution, etc.)
